summary: Provision masked request/response roster for EU data-governance audit
description:
Issue summary: Request from Legal/Governance for a timeboxed, masked roster of request/response pairs (request metadata + hashed identifiers + redacted response snippets) to support an EU regulatory audit.

Impact: Audit team requires sample data covering last 90 days for two customer workloads provisioned in eu-west. No customer-identifiable plaintext should leave production logs. This is an internal-only deliverable for governance and will be handed to Legal under strict controls.

Request details:
- Data scope: request headers, request prompts (first 512 chars), response first-turn and final-turn snippets (first 512 chars), timestamps, route/model used, and anonymized session id.
- Minimization: redact PII and free-text sensitive content using existing redaction patterns, then apply field-level HMAC on session ids.
- Sampling: 0.5% deterministic sample stratified by route and model to ensure representation.
- Time window: last 90 days (2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28).
- Access window: 72-hour, timeboxed S3 read-only presigned URL with IP allowlist to Legal team.
- Audit trail: every access must be logged and replicated to audit-log-cluster.

Required approvals: Privacy lead (Olivia Chen), InfoSec approval for transfer mechanism (JIRA INT-approval), and SRE signoff on performance impact.

Deliverables:
1) Masking/redaction script (Py tool) and checklist.
2) Zip archive with manifest describing each file and redaction hashes.
3) Short runbook describing how to regenerate sample and revoke access.

Constraints/considerations:
- Avoid full-session exports; only include the sampled roster.
- Ensure KV-cache contents and raw token traces are excluded.
- Keep the dataset below 5GB if possible to simplify transfer and storage.

Acceptance criteria:
- Privacy lead confirms redaction patterns applied.
- InfoSec confirms storage/transfer path meets EU data handling requirements.
- Governance signs off that sample is sufficient for audit questions.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Confirm sampling selectors match audit criteria (route, model, date range)
2) Run redaction script in staging on snapshot to verify patterns (tool: tools/redact_roster.py PR 8123)
3) Generate manifest with SHA256 of output files and HMAC of session ids
4) Upload to restricted S3 bucket and create presigned URL with IP allowlist
investigation_notes: 2026-02-21: Ran a dry-run on a 7-day window in staging. Redaction patterns removed email addresses and credit-card-like tokens, but missed some phone number formats (pattern updated).
2026-02-24: Updated redact list to include international phone regex; re-ran sample and verified with Privacy lead.

2026-02-26: Performance check: extractor job uses streaming read to avoid OOM; expected runtime for 90-day window ~3 hours on dedicated batch worker. SRE requested throttling to keep CPU usage under 60%.
2026-03-02: InfoSec asked to replace presigned URL with short-lived S3 Access Point and MFA-protected temporary credentials; small changes to upload script required (PR referenced).
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) - 2026-02-20: Created task after Legal asked for EU audit artifacts. Priority set to P2 to balance urgency with minimization requirements.
Marco Stein (Assignee) - 2026-02-21: Completed initial sampling logic and ran staging dry-run. Found missing phone patterns; pushed update to redaction script (linked PR).
Olivia Chen (Privacy) - 2026-02-24: Reviewed redaction output from dry-run and approved pattern changes; request that HMAC key is rotated before use.
SRE-Ops (SRE) - 2026-02-26: Noted extractor will spike IO; recommend running job on dedicated batch node during off-peak window. Requested 2-hour maintenance window to ensure no impact.
InfoSec (K. Martinez) - 2026-03-02: Prefer Access Point + short-lived credentials vs presigned URL. Also require documented retention policy for archive. Waiting on updated upload script.

Marco Stein - 2026-03-04: Uploaded masked roster to restricted S3 Access Point; access URL and audit steps provided to Legal in encrypted email. Pending final InfoSec confirmation and Privacy sign-off to close.
resolution_summary: Prepared and delivered masked request/response roster to Legal via S3 Access Point with timeboxed credentials. Applied updated redaction patterns and HMACed session ids. Retention set to 30 days for the archive. InfoSec requested follow-up to document process in Confluence — assigned to Marco for runbook update. Case remains open until Confluence entry and rotation confirmation (next update target 2026-03-08).
next_steps: Marco to update Confluence runbook with step-by-step and revoke checklist (due 2026-03-08)
Privacy to confirm HMAC key rotation completed and record key fingerprint
InfoSec to close final compliance sign-off once runbook exists and access logs validated
estimated_time_to_complete: 8 hours (including SRE coordination and runbook write-up)
sensitive_handling_notes: Do not store decrypted copies of exported responses on local machines. All artifacts must remain in restricted S3 with Audit Logging enabled. Any transfer to Legal must be documented and approved by InfoSec.
